name: dev.adrkit/mcp
title: adrkit decision memory
description: Deterministic, offline, read-only ADR decision memory for coding agents. No model or network calls.

environmentVariables.name: ADRKIT_MCP_CWD
environmentVariables.description: Repository root; must contain a readable .git entry. Defaults to the process working directory.

environmentVariables.name: ADRKIT_MCP_DIR
environmentVariables.description: ADR directory, resolved against the root and required to stay contained within it. Defaults to docs/adr.
